title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree Summary Of The Lesson Of Divine Unity

questions.question: What lesson did the traveler get from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He learned about faith and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What book points people to Allah’s existence and oneness?
questions.answer: The Qur'an.

questions.question: Which groups are said to welcome and want this book?
questions.answer: Angels, humans, and jinn.

questions.question: How often are its verses read?
questions.answer: They are read all the time, every minute.

questions.question: How do people read it?
questions.answer: With great respect.

questions.question: About how many people read it?
questions.answer: Hundreds of millions of people.

questions.question: How long has its rule and guidance continued?
questions.answer: For more than fourteen centuries.

questions.question: Over how much of the earth and humanity has its bright spiritual influence spread?
questions.answer: Over half the earth and about one-fifth of people.

questions.question: What in the Qur'an agrees together to give proof?
questions.answer: Its surahs, verses, meanings, lights, fruits, and effects.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand about faith?
questions.answer: It is the most valuable thing a person can have.

questions.question: What does faith give to a poor and weak person?
questions.answer: A forever home and an everlasting kingdom.

questions.question: What does faith save a person from?
questions.answer: Endless destruction.

questions.question: What does faith open for a person?
questions.answer: An eternal treasure of lasting happiness.

questions.question: What two big ideas are taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What sentence of belief is the passage explaining?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What makes the Qur'an special in this passage?
questions.answer: It is shown as a wonderful book that gives clear proof.

questions.question: Who reads the Qur'an besides people?
questions.answer: Angels and jinn.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur'an’s holy rule?
questions.answer: It continues and does not fade away.

questions.question: What kind of authority of the Qur'an is mentioned?
questions.answer: A spiritual and shining authority.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention many surahs and verses agreeing together?
questions.answer: To show that the Qur'an gives strong proof, not a weak one.

questions.question: What does “by seeing clearly” mean here?
questions.answer: The signs are plain and can be noticed.

questions.question: Why is faith called a person’s best wealth?
questions.answer: Because it helps in this life and the next life.

questions.question: Does faith only give a small reward for a short time?
questions.answer: No. It gives something lasting and very great.

questions.question: What picture is used for what faith gives?
questions.answer: A huge forever home or kingdom.

questions.question: What kind of happiness does faith lead to?
questions.answer: Happiness that never ends.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the traveler now know for sure?
questions.answer: That faith is very precious.

questions.question: What truth does the Qur'an point to about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah truly exists and is One.

questions.question: Why is the Qur'an important for many creatures?
questions.answer: Because it is accepted and wanted by angels, humans, and jinn.

questions.question: What shows that the Qur'an is loved by many people?
questions.answer: So many people keep reading it with respect.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur'an through many centuries?
questions.answer: Its influence has stayed strong for a very long time.

questions.question: What does it mean that the Qur'an’s spiritual reach covers much of the world?
questions.answer: Many people and places have been guided by it.

questions.question: What parts of the Qur'an work together in giving witness?
questions.answer: Its chapters, verses, inner meanings, lights, results, and signs.

questions.question: Are the proofs in the passage shown as mixed-up or matching?
questions.answer: They are shown as matching and supporting each other.

questions.question: What does faith give instead of only a short worldly place?
questions.answer: A forever place as wide and great as creation.

questions.question: What kind of person especially needs faith in this passage?
questions.answer: A needy, weak, temporary human being.

questions.question: What does faith prepare a person for?
questions.answer: Everlasting life.

questions.question: What sad ending does faith protect a person from?
questions.answer: Eternal ruin.

questions.question: What treasure does faith open?
questions.answer: A treasure of everlasting joy.

questions.question: What is the main message of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Qur'an proves Allah’s oneness, and faith is a priceless gift.

questions.question: What was said briefly about the traveler’s lesson from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He was taught the basics of iman and tawhid.

questions.question: What does tawhid mean here?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: What book is described as giving evidence for this truth?
questions.answer: The Qur'an.

questions.question: Which three kinds of beings are named as turning to this book?
questions.answer: Angels, people, and jinn.

questions.question: What does the large number of readers tell us?
questions.answer: That the Qur'an is followed and honored by many.

questions.question: What feeling should a Muslim have when reading the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Respect and honor.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur'an’s holy power over time?
questions.answer: It has remained through many ages.

questions.question: For how many centuries has its shining moral rule continued?
questions.answer: More than fourteen centuries.

questions.question: Why does the passage list many ways the Qur'an agrees with itself?
questions.answer: To show that its message is true and firm.

questions.question: What does the traveler learn next about iman?
questions.answer: It is a person’s greatest treasure.

questions.question: What does faith give that a short earthly home cannot give?
questions.answer: A forever home and kingdom.

questions.question: How does faith help with the hereafter?
questions.answer: It gives what is needed for eternal life.

questions.question: How does faith help a person facing death?
questions.answer: It saves the person from endless loss.

questions.question: What is opened by faith at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: A store of never-ending happiness.

questions.question: What subject comes first in the passage before the traveler speaks again?
questions.answer: A short teaching about belief in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is at the center of this teaching?
questions.answer: Only Allah is truly God.

questions.question: What role does the Qur'an have in this teaching?
questions.answer: It points and gives proof to that truth.

questions.question: Why is it important that the Qur'an is read by so many?
questions.answer: It shows that its message has reached many hearts.

questions.question: What is special about the way it is read?
questions.answer: It is read with deep respect.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur'an’s place in the world?
questions.answer: Its sacred influence has lasted across lands and times.

questions.question: What fraction of humanity is mentioned?
questions.answer: About one-fifth.

questions.question: What fraction of the earth is mentioned?
questions.answer: About half.

questions.question: What gives extra strength to the Qur'an’s witness in the passage?
questions.answer: The harmony of its chapters, verses, secrets, meanings, fruits, and results.

questions.question: What did the traveler realize a human being needs most?
questions.answer: Faith.

questions.question: Why is faith better than getting only something in this world?
questions.answer: Because faith gives blessings that last forever.

questions.question: What does faith give after this short life ends?
questions.answer: What a person needs for eternal life.

questions.question: What dark future does faith remove?
questions.answer: Everlasting destruction.

questions.question: What joyful future does faith open?
questions.answer: Endless happiness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Qur'an teach the traveler?
questions.answer: It teaches him true belief and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah besides His oneness?
questions.answer: That His existence is certain and necessary.

questions.question: Which book is shown as a clear sign of these truths?
questions.answer: The Qur'an.

questions.question: Who are the kinds of beings connected to this book in the passage?
questions.answer: Angels, humans, and jinn.

questions.question: What do the many readers do each minute?
questions.answer: They recite its verses.

questions.question: How should Allah’s book be treated when it is recited?
questions.answer: With full respect.

questions.question: What do the long years of the Qur'an’s influence help show?
questions.answer: That its guidance is lasting and powerful.

questions.question: Is the Qur'an’s authority described as only physical or also spiritual?
questions.answer: Also spiritual.

questions.question: What things in the Qur'an match one another as proofs?
questions.answer: Its surahs, verses, secrets, lights, truths, fruits, and effects.

questions.question: What big idea did the traveler understand after this?
questions.answer: Faith is the best capital a person can have.

questions.question: Why is a human being called needy in this part?
questions.answer: Because people need help, safety, and lasting hope.

questions.question: What does faith promise beyond this temporary life?
questions.answer: An everlasting life and kingdom.

questions.question: How does faith change a person’s end?
questions.answer: It turns loss into safety and hope.

questions.question: What does faith finally open for the believer?
questions.answer: An eternal treasure of happiness.
